title: Exploring the Impact of Urolithins A and B on Muscle Health: A Transcriptomic Analysis in Human Myotubes.
design: In vitro transcriptomic study (primary human myotubes; RNA-seq with RT-qPCR/ELISA validation)

outcomes.name: Oxidative phosphorylation / mitochondrial pathway enrichment (IPA)
outcomes.effect_text: affected oxidative phosphorylation, mitochondrial dysfunction (z score 2.11)

outcomes.name: TGFBI protein levels (ELISA)
outcomes.effect_text: reduced TGFBI protein levels dose-dependently (UA r2 = 0.8582; UB r2 = 0.7415)
